body:
Closing this PR as we've decided to address this issue at the search client adapter level instead.

The fix has been implemented in the Searchkit adapter and submitted as a PR: https://github.com/searchkit/searchkit/pull/1412

The key changes in the Searchkit fix:

* Added configurable timeout (default 30s) to `ESTransporter` using `AbortController`
* Modified `@searchkit/instantsearch-client` to return empty results on error instead of throwing, which prevents the infinite re-render loop in InstantSearch
* Added error result caching to prevent repeated failing requests
* Added optional `onError` callback for custom error handling

This approach keeps the error handling closer to the source (the search client) and avoids needing to patch `react-instantsearch-nextjs`. Once the Searchkit PR is merged, users of Searchkit with InstantSearch will get this fix automatically.

Thanks @Haroenv for your support and guidance on this issue!
